methodologyNotes: Re-verified by fetching each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-18: beehiiv.com/pricing, ghost.org/pricing/, buttondown.com/pricing, kit.com/pricing, mailerlite.com/pricing, flodesk.com/pricing, curated.co/pages/pricing.html, substack.com/about + substack.com/going-paid. Dynamic slider prices (MailerLite, Flodesk, Kit, Buttondown) corroborated via WebSearch against multiple 2026 third-party pricing trackers. KEY VERIFICATIONS: beehiiv Scale $49/mo monthly ($43 annual), Max $109/mo monthly ($96 annual); Kit Creator $39/mo monthly ($33 annual), Pro $79/mo monthly ($66 annual) — official page headlines the annual figure but monthly billing is higher; Ghost Starter $18/$15, Publisher $35/$29, Business $239/$199 (monthly/annual); MailerLite Comfort/Power are the CURRENT LIVE names (Free/Comfort/Power/Enterprise) with Comfort $12 and Power $25 starting at 500 subs, 10% annual discount; Flodesk retired its flat unlimited plan for new members Dec 2, 2025 and now prices by subscriber tier (Lite $25/$19, Pro $28/$25, Everything $54/$49 at 1,000 subs); Curated's live pricing URL is curated.co/pages/pricing.html (curated.co/pricing returns 404); Substack is free to publish with a 10% revenue cut. CORRECTION vs draft: the draft asserted Substack's about/pricing URL returned 404 — it actually returns HTTP 200; provenance corrected. Compliance set true only where explicitly stated (beehiiv SOC 2 Type II + GDPR on /enterprise). accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: beehiiv
vendors.provenance: Fetched beehiiv.com/pricing on 2026-06-18; plan names, prices, and limits taken directly from that page. Scale $49/mo monthly ($43 annual, $517/yr) and Max $109/mo monthly ($96 annual, $1,151/yr) confirmed and corroborated via 2026 third-party trackers. SOC 2 Type II and GDPR explicitly stated on beehiiv.com/enterprise.

plans.name: Launch
plans.notes: Up to 2,500 active subscribers. Unlimited email sends, newsletter website, podcast, custom domain, basic analytics, read-only API access. No paid subscription monetization. Forever free.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Up to 100,000 active subscribers. Includes Ad Network, Boosts, 0% take rate on paid subscriptions, digital products, automations, surveys, advanced analytics, 3 team seats, human support. $49/mo monthly billing; $43/mo billed annually ($517/yr).

plans.name: Max
plans.notes: Up to 100,000 active subscribers. All Scale features plus white-label (remove branding), sponsorship storefront, audio newsletters, RSS to Send, up to 10 publications, unlimited team seats, priority support, Getty image credits. $109/mo monthly billing; $96/mo billed annually ($1,151/yr).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: 100K+ subscribers, custom pricing (no published price). Concierge onboarding, dedicated account manager, dedicated IPs, Send API, VIP support, SSO.

keyFeatures: Built-in Ad Network and Boosts for monetization
0% take rate on paid subscriptions (all paid plans)
Web + podcast + audio newsletter in one platform
Referral and growth tools built-in
enrichment.provenance: Plan details from beehiiv.com/pricing; compliance from beehiiv.com/enterprise where SOC 2 Type II ('We are SOC 2 Type II compliant') and GDPR are explicitly stated. HIPAA not mentioned (null).

vendors.name: Substack
vendors.provenance: substack.com/about and substack.com/going-paid both load (HTTP 200) and explicitly state writers keep 90% of revenue (Substack takes 10%), with no platform fees/tiers/contracts; publishing is free at any list size. Stripe processing fees apply on top of the 10% cut. Corroborated via ruzuku.com Substack pricing article.

plans.name: Free to publish
plans.notes: Free to publish and send email newsletters to any size list. Substack takes 10% of paid subscription revenue when monetization is enabled, plus Stripe processing fees. No monthly fee at any subscriber count.

limits: 10% revenue cut on all paid subscriptions
No self-serve removal of Substack branding on free tier
keyFeatures: Fully free to publish at any list size
Built-in discovery network and recommendations
Podcast, video, and chat alongside newsletters
No monthly platform fee — cost only triggers on paid subscriber revenue
enrichment.provenance: Pricing model (10% revenue cut, free to publish, no platform fee) confirmed directly on substack.com/about and substack.com/going-paid (both HTTP 200), corroborated by an independent source. NOTE: draft previously claimed the about/pricing URL returned 404 — that is incorrect; the URL is live.

vendors.name: Ghost
vendors.provenance: Fetched ghost.org/pricing/ on 2026-06-18; annual prices ($15 Starter / $29 Publisher / $199 Business) and monthly-billing prices ($18 / $35 / $239) confirmed, corroborated via Ghost forum thread on the July 2025 pricing update. Ghost is also available self-hosted for free (MIT open source). There is no forever-free Ghost(Pro) HOSTED plan — only a 14-day trial; the $0 entry is the self-hosted option.

plans.name: Self-hosted (open source)
plans.notes: Ghost CMS is MIT-licensed open source. Self-hosted on your own infrastructure at no license cost. Requires server, domain, and email sending setup (not managed by Ghost).

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 1,000 members, 1 staff user, 1 email newsletter, no paid subscriptions, no custom themes. $18/mo monthly billing; $15/mo billed annually. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

plans.name: Publisher
plans.notes: 1,000 members, 3 staff users, 3 email newsletters, paid subscriptions enabled, custom themes, 8,000+ integrations. $35/mo monthly billing; $29/mo billed annually. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: 10,000 members, 15 staff users, 10 email newsletters, paid subscriptions, premium tiers, special offers, priority support. $239/mo monthly billing; $199/mo billed annually. 14-day free trial.

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: Unlimited members and staff users, dedicated IP, 99.9% uptime SLA, SSO authentication. Contact sales for pricing (no published price).

limits: No forever-free hosted plan (Ghost Pro is 14-day trial; $0 is self-hosted only)
keyFeatures: 0% transaction fee on paid memberships (all Ghost Pro plans)
Open-source self-hosted option at no license cost
Custom themes and full design control on Publisher+
Built-in membership and paid subscription management
enrichment.provenance: Plan features and prices from ghost.org/pricing/; monthly-vs-annual prices corroborated via official Ghost forum thread on the July 2025 pricing update. The $0 'free tier' is the self-hosted open-source option, not a free Ghost(Pro) hosted plan.

vendors.name: Buttondown
vendors.provenance: Fetched buttondown.com/pricing on 2026-06-18. Confirmed modular à la carte model: free base (first 100 subscribers) + subscriber-based base pricing via interactive calculator + per-feature add-ons (+$9 / +$29 / +$79 per month). No fixed named paid tiers are published, so the paid plan is recorded with monthlyUsd=null (NULL beats a guess).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 100 subscribers. Includes rich text and Markdown editor, custom domain sending, hosted newsletter archives. No add-ons included.

plans.name: Paid (subscriber-based, add-ons à la carte)
plans.notes: Base cost scales with active subscriber count above 100 (interactive calculator on the pricing page — no single published flat price). Add-ons priced separately: tagging/segmentation, paid subscriptions, comments, analytics, RSS-to-email, sponsorships, attachments each +$9/mo; custom domain archives, multiple newsletters, automations each +$29/mo; whitelabeling, teams each +$79/mo. 50% nonprofit discount. One email/day to full list included; higher frequency requires custom plan.

limits: 1 email/day to full list on standard paid plans
Paid base price is calculator-driven (no single published flat price)
keyFeatures: Modular à la carte pricing — pay only for features you use
0% revenue cut on paid subscriptions (vs Substack's 10%)
Markdown-first editor with developer-friendly API
Privacy-first — no tracking pixels by default
enrichment.provenance: Official buttondown.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-18; confirms modular add-on model with subscriber-based base pricing via calculator and +$9/+$29/+$79 add-ons. No fixed named paid tier price published — recorded as null rather than guessed.

vendors.name: Kit (formerly ConvertKit)
vendors.provenance: Fetched kit.com/pricing on 2026-06-18. Newsletter plan free up to 10,000 subscribers confirmed. Creator $39/mo monthly ($33 annual) and Pro $79/mo monthly ($66 annual) at the 1,000-subscriber baseline — the official page headlines the annual figure but monthly-billing prices are higher, confirmed via WebSearch (EmailTooltester, EmailVendorSelection 2026). Prices scale with subscriber count. 14-day free trial, no card.

plans.name: Newsletter
plans.notes: Up to 10,000 subscribers. Unlimited landing pages and forms, unlimited email broadcasts, 1 basic Visual Automation, audience tagging and segmentation, digital product sales. No sequences or A/B testing. Forever free.

plans.name: Creator
plans.notes: $39/mo monthly billing (1,000 subscribers) or $33/mo billed annually ($390/yr). Scales with subscriber count: ~$59/mo at 3,000, ~$89/mo at 5,000. Includes unlimited Visual Automations, unlimited email sequences, A/B testing, SMS marketing, Kit MCP, 24/7 support. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $79/mo monthly billing (1,000 subscribers) or $66/mo billed annually ($790/yr). Scales with subscriber count. Includes everything in Creator plus Subscriber Signals, engagement analytics, unlimited users, insights dashboard, deliverability reporting, collaborative editing, Facebook Custom Audiences, newsletter referral system, 24/7 priority support. 14-day free trial.

limits: Paid plans price scales with subscriber count above 1,000
keyFeatures: Visual Automation builder for subscriber journeys
Built-in digital product and course sales
Newsletter referral system on Pro
SMS marketing included on paid plans
enrichment.provenance: Base prices from kit.com/pricing (monthly-billing $39/$79 confirmed distinct from annual $33/$66); subscriber-tier scaling corroborated via third-party price trackers citing Kit's official pricing calculator.

vendors.name: MailerLite
vendors.provenance: Fetched mailerlite.com/pricing and mailerlite.com/help/plan-and-billing on 2026-06-18. Current LIVE plan names confirmed as Free / Comfort / Power / Enterprise (the Comfort/Power naming is live, not pending). Comfort starts $12/mo and Power starts $25/mo at 500 subscribers; 10% annual discount. Per-tier scaling corroborated via emailvendorselection.com.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 250 active subscribers, 2,500 monthly emails, 2 user seats, 1 website and landing page, 3 signup forms. All email editors included. MailerLite branding on emails. Forever free.

plans.name: Comfort
plans.notes: Starts at $12/mo monthly billing (~500 subscribers). Scales with subscriber count: ~$15/mo at 1,000, ~$25/mo at 2,500, ~$39/mo at 5,000. 3 user seats, 10x monthly email send ceiling vs subscriber tier, unlimited templates, dynamic emails, campaign auto-resend, multivariate testing, AI writing assistant, smart sending. 10% discount billed annually.

plans.name: Power
plans.notes: Starts at $25/mo monthly billing (~500 subscribers). Scales with subscriber count: ~$30/mo at 1,000, ~$40/mo at 2,500, ~$50/mo at 5,000. Unlimited user seats, unlimited monthly emails, unlimited automations, forms, digital products, and bookings, multiple automation triggers, 24/7 live chat support, partner discounts. 10% discount billed annually.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: 200,000+ subscribers. Custom pricing (no published price). Dedicated success manager, custom sending volume, unlimited user seats, account audits, deliverability support.

limits: Comfort plan: 10x subscriber-tier monthly send ceiling
keyFeatures: Digital products and bookings built-in (Power plan)
AI writing assistant on all paid plans
14-day premium feature trial on free plan
Subscriber-based pricing with very competitive entry price ($12/mo)
enrichment.provenance: Plan names (Free/Comfort/Power/Enterprise) confirmed LIVE on mailerlite.com/help/plan-and-billing; starting prices from official pricing page; per-subscriber-tier prices corroborated by emailvendorselection.com. GDPR=true per MailerLite's public GDPR commitment; SOC 2 and HIPAA not explicitly claimed (null).

vendors.name: Flodesk
vendors.provenance: Fetched flodesk.com/pricing on 2026-06-18; page renders prices via an interactive slider (1,000-255,000+ subscribers). Prices at 1,000 subscribers corroborated via mailtoolfinder.com/blog/flodesk-pricing-changes-2026/ and WebSearch (EmailTooltester 2026): Lite $25/$19, Pro $28/$25, Everything $54/$49 (monthly/annual). Flat unlimited plan retired for new members Dec 2, 2025. Annual billing = '1 month free' (~8% discount).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Tools to grow your list. Forms, landing pages, audience segmentation, email sending, designer templates. Limited feature set — no workflows, no analytics, no checkout. Forever free.

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: $25/mo monthly billing (up to 1,000 subscribers) or $19/mo billed annually. Scales with subscriber count up to 25,000 max on this plan. 1 seat. Unlimited email sends, email analytics, one workflow.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $28/mo monthly billing (up to 1,000 subscribers) or $25/mo billed annually. Scales up to 255,000 subscribers. 2 seats. Unlimited email sends, unlimited workflows, advanced analytics and reporting, optional Flodesk footer removal.

plans.name: Everything
plans.notes: $54/mo monthly billing (up to 1,000 subscribers) or $49/mo billed annually. Scales up to 255,000 subscribers. 3 seats. All Pro features plus unlimited integrated checkouts, sales pages and funnels, subscription and payment plans, abandoned cart automations.

limits: 255,000 subscriber max on Pro and Everything plans
keyFeatures: Premium design-forward email templates
Built-in e-commerce checkouts and sales funnels on Everything plan
Abandoned cart automations
Flat pricing model retired Dec 2, 2025 — now subscriber-based
enrichment.provenance: Official pricing page fetched but dynamic slider prices not readable in static HTML; prices at 1,000 subscribers (Lite $25/$19, Pro $28/$25, Everything $54/$49 monthly/annual) corroborated by mailtoolfinder.com and WebSearch covering the Dec 2025 model change.
